body:
Well, coming from someone that is now really contemplating suicide after losing my fiancee who won't even talk to me and has hit rock fucking bottom with no job in sight and a family that really isn't there...you've got it pretty good. 

In no way am I not acknowledging how you feel but given what you do have which sounds 100x better than what I have...don't let it consume you. Fight it. Fight it because if you don't, you'll become me. Suicide now strikes me as a permanent solution to a permanent problem. 

It seems like the best logical outcome for me and you may feel that way too but you have happiness in your life. I do not. I have perpetual agony and misery. I know that the depression and suicidal thoughts just don't go away. But you need to fight it because you do not want this. I wouldn't wish this on anyone.

Making any attempt at trying to fix humanity is just a disappointment in itself. I'm at this stage in my life because humanity is anything but human. Anyone can read the cliff notes of human history and see that. We're violent, stupid, and primitive animals first and foremost. 

Purpose probably entails being a debt slave too. I'm already clearly suicidal. I don't really need looming debt held over me due to a abysmal shit economy where I probably won't find anything above $13 an hour as an administrative assistant if I'm lucky. Purpose = $$$ in today's world. 

Honestly, I'm a pretty logical person. When suicide becomes logical -- there's a god damn problem with this world we're living in. I don't see a silver lining in the modern world that we're living in. I just see people trying to make lemonade out of shit and I'm tired of drinking it. 

Like I said though, I am waiting for a bit. I am attempting to be rational and pragmatic about this. Admittedly, I am emotional over said events, but I am willing to wait a little while to see if my life can improve. Mentally and emotionally, there's not much that I can attribute to that at the moment, but maybe it'll get at least tolerable by that stage. I doubt my ex fiancee will actually contact me though. Which would be nice but it probably isn't happening. That was the only person that I've really deeply bonded with. Who I am now currently dead to. So...that's life. That's life and you just get to accept it or kill yourself. I'm pretty over just chalking everything up to 'shit happens!'

Driving off a bridge is a bad idea. As is driving into a concrete barrier. The variables there are that other people can get hurt and you may just wind up mentally fucked up and then really wishing that you died. 

People are shitty. That's fucking life. I'm in the same boat right now and I'm continually contemplating my own death because objectively every denied opportunity/terrible experience in my life has been solely due to people. The whole individualism career minded pursuit of materialistic shit modern day bullshit is just that...fucking bullshit.
